result.reconciled: Released {{released}} orphaned boxes, reclaimed {{reclaimed}} boxes for active orders

autoCancel.title: Auto-cancel unconfirmed orders
autoCancel.description: Cancels INITIALIZED orders past their hold window, releases the box and refunds promotion usage: unpaid orders after the «auto-cancel-unpaid-minutes» setting, paid orders never dropped off after the «auto-cancel-hours» setting.
autoCancel.confirm: Every INITIALIZED order past its hold window is canceled immediately and its box released. This cannot be undone.

releaseBoxes.title: Release boxes of completed orders
releaseBoxes.description: Safety net: sweeps COMPLETED orders and releases any box still held (e.g. orders completed through the legacy API).
releaseBoxes.frequency: Daily at 03:15 (server time UTC, 10:15 Vietnam time)

pickupReminders.title: Overdue pickup reminders
pickupReminders.description: Notifies the sender (and receiver, if any) of stored orders past their pickup deadline; each order is reminded again only after the «reminder-cooldown-minutes» setting.

releaseOverdue.title: Move long-overdue orders to storage
releaseOverdue.description: Stored orders overdue longer than the «overdue-release-hours» setting: finalizes the overtime fee, moves them to EXPIRED (items go to storage), releases the box, revokes the PIN and notifies the customer.
releaseOverdue.confirm: Long-overdue orders become EXPIRED, get the overtime fee, lose their PIN and their box is released for other orders; customers are notified. This cannot be undone.

reconcileBoxes.title: Reconcile box states
reconcileBoxes.description: Compares box states in locker-service with active orders: releases RESERVED/OCCUPIED boxes no order holds, and reclaims AVAILABLE boxes that still belong to an active order.
reconcileBoxes.confirm: Box states across all lockers may be changed to match active orders. Prefer running it when no drop-off/pickup is in progress.
